pages.text: SYN Business Review analyst note on Mwanga Bank (SYN). The analyst set a twelve-month target price of SYN Sh 153.04 for MWA2. The note cites steady demand in the bank sector and cost control at Mwanga Bank (SYN). Trading volumes were broadly in line with the previous month, according to exchange data. Officials declined to comment on whether further changes were planned. Analysts at several brokerages said they expected conditions to stay stable through the quarter. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
